map.单件毛利=售价−成本（绝对额，元），毛利率=毛利÷售价×100%（相对比例）。毛: Per-unit gross profit = price - cost (an absolute amount, yuan), gross margin = gross profit / price x 100% (a relative ratio). Gross margin excludes the effect of the price magnitude and is better for comparison across categories and price levels.
map.竞品价格带不完整会影响结论吗？: Will an incomplete competitor price band affect the conclusion?
